div.head: Iud Dei X 18.1
div.ab: In tertia uero parte foueae fustes fortissimi cum cleta fortissima ponantur desuper, ad sustinendum uidelicet sacerdotem aquam benedicentem et iudices desuper assistentes et hominem intraturum in aquam, cum duobus uel tribus hominibus eum ibidem demittentibus.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 417 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: Vielleicht ‘Urtheilfinder’ neben dem Einen Gerichtsvorsitzenden? oder Iusticiarii regis.
Perhaps ‘judgment-finders’ alongside the one presiding judge? or Iusticiarii regis.

div.ab: Over a third part of the pit let very strong beams with a very strong hurdle be laid on top, namely to support the priest blessing the water and the judges standing by above, and the man about to enter the water, with two or three men lowering him there.
